Pinch your nose and hum
Pinch your nose and hum
Keep humming,
as long as you can.
It stops.
Air fills your mouth,
and the hum is gone.
When you hum,
the air leaves through your nose.
Pinch your nose shut,
and the air piles up
above your vocal folds.
The pressure there
climbs until it almost
matches your lungs.
With no push across
them,
the folds stop vibrating.
Pinch your nose,
and try again.
